## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Order Line
where: Order (uses), src/ordering/domain/order.ts, component ordering

=====SOURCE-END=====

### B
concept: Order

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
const subtotal = order.subtotal();
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A and B are related but are not the same concept. A is the Order Line, a single line item in an order. In src/ordering/domain/order.ts the Order class holds a collection of them: `readonly lines: readonly OrderLine[],`. B is the Order itself, the aggregate that contains those lines. OrderNotificationService (node ee110f001f97012a) calls Order.subtotal in `const subtotal = order.subtotal();`. An order owns many order lines, so this is a part-and-whole link between two different business things, not one thing under two names.
